Today my attention is on the outstanding reports.
Today's focus is the outstanding reports. Tell colleagues where your attention is directed.
Mijn aandacht is the singular subject of gaat. Naar de openstaande meldingen names its figurative direction; the sentence does not describe physical movement.
We completed the first check this morning.
Your team completed the first check this morning. Report that completed work.
Hebben afgerond is perfect with separable afronden. Vanmorgen sets the completed action this morning; de eerste controle is the object, not the subject.
I am going to call the user back shortly.
You plan to call the user back shortly. Announce that upcoming callback.
Ga is finite with ik, while terugbellen remains a joined infinitive. Straks gives a near-future time without specifying an exact minute.
The documentation still needs some attention.
The documentation still needs some attention. Identify it as work remaining in your update.
Vraagt means needs here, rather than asks a spoken question. Nog marks the remaining need and wat aandacht means some attention.
My colleague is making the final adjustments.
Your colleague is currently making the final adjustments. Report that ongoing work.
Is bezig met describes an activity in progress. Met introduces the noun phrase de laatste aanpassingen; this is not a completed perfect.
Yesterday the emphasis was on testing.
During your team meeting, yesterday the team's emphasis was on testing. Describe that earlier focus.
Gisteren is fronted, followed by finite past lag and subject de nadruk. Het testen is a nominalised infinitive naming the testing activity after op.
I do not need extra help for this task.
You can handle the task without extra help. Explain that you do not need additional assistance for it.
Heb ... nodig means need. Geen extra hulp negates an indefinite amount of help; voor deze taak limits the statement to this task, not every task.
I will report it if the plan changes.
You will inform colleagues if the plan changes. State that conditional commitment.
Meld is present with a future commitment reading. Het anticipates the event in the als-clause; verandert is final with singular subject de planning.
We can start the second round today.
Your team is able to start the second round today. Give that readiness update.
Kunnen is finite with we and beginnen stays infinitive. Met de tweede ronde names the activity begun; it is a preposition phrase, not a direct object.
You need an update on preparation. Ask how the preparation is going.
Hoe staat het met is a fixed status question. Staat is finite before het; met de voorbereiding names the topic, not a physical standing position.
The biggest risk is the limited testing time.
Limited time for testing is the biggest risk. Identify that risk in your update.
Het grootste risico is singular with is. De beperkte testtijd is the noun complement identifying the risk, not an object receiving an action.
The user has just confirmed the appointment.
The user has just confirmed the appointment. Add that newly completed confirmation to the update.
Heeft bevestigd is perfect with singular de gebruiker. Zojuist means just now; de afspraak is the confirmed appointment in this situation.
S=Ik|AUX=heb|O=de eerste versie van het verslag|PT=geschreven.
I have written the first version of the report.
You finished writing the first draft of the report. Tell the team what you have completed.
Heb geschreven is perfect with the irregular participle geschreven. De eerste versie limits the completed writing to the first draft, not a final approved report.
We have merged the duplicate tickets.
Your team merged the duplicate tickets. Report that completed consolidation without calling it deletion.
Hebben samengevoegd is perfect with separable samenvoegen. Dubbele modifies tickets; merging their records is a different action from deleting them.
The administrator has revoked the old access.
During your team meeting, the administrator revoked the old access. Report that completed permission change.
Heeft ingetrokken is perfect with separable intrekken. De beheerder is the actor; de oude toegang is the access revoked.
I have finished the user list.
You finished work on the user list. Report completion of that task.
Ben klaargekomen is perfect with zijn. Met de gebruikerslijst specifies the task completed and makes the work-related meaning of klaarkomen clear.
The new procedure has not yet been approved.
A new procedure has been prepared but still lacks approval. Explain that approval is pending.
Is goedgekeurd is passive perfect here. Nog niet means not yet; preparation alone does not make the procedure approved.
We have discussed the findings with the team leader.
Your team discussed the findings with the team leader. Report that completed discussion.
Hebben besproken forms the perfect with inseparable bespreken. Met de teamleider gives the discussion partner, not an approver whose agreement is asserted.
The check took longer than expected.
A check took longer than expected. Report its actual duration compared with the expectation.
Duurde is the singular simple past of duren, not a perfect construction. Langer dan verwacht is a duration comparison with the expected length.
I have informed the new colleagues about the procedure.
You informed your new colleagues about the procedure. Report that completed communication.
Heb geïnformeerd is perfect; the diaeresis marks the vowel boundary. De nieuwe collega's are the people informed, and over de werkwijze names the topic.
We now know which functions are available.
Your team now knows which functions are available. Describe the knowledge gained.
Weten expresses knowledge of the embedded answer. Welke functies is the embedded plural subject and zijn is final; nu identifies the current knowledge state.
The check has not yielded any new errors.
The check yielded no new errors. Report that result without claiming that all possible errors are ruled out.
Heeft opgeleverd is perfect with separable opleveren. Geen nieuwe fouten negates new errors found by this check, not every possible defect.
You want to know what changed since Monday. Ask about the changes during that interval.
Wat is the question subject. Is veranderd forms the perfect with zijn; er introduces the occurrence, and sinds maandag sets the interval's start.
The test does not cover external access yet.
The current test does not cover external access yet. State that scope limitation.
Dekt is present and means covers in scope. Nog niet means not yet; the sentence limits what this test covers rather than saying external access is broken.
F=Er|V=is|S=nog geen eigenaar voor deze taak.
There is no owner for this task yet.
A task has no owner yet. Raise that missing responsibility in the team meeting.
Er introduces existence. Geen eigenaar is the singular subject of is; nog geen means no owner yet and voor deze taak identifies the unassigned task.
We need to clarify the requirements first.
Your team must clarify the requirements before proceeding. State that first necessary action.
Moeten expresses necessity and verduidelijken stays infinitive. Eerst puts clarification before the next step; de vereisten is the object to clarify.
The supplier has not confirmed a date yet.
The supplier has not confirmed a date yet. Report that missing external confirmation.
Heeft bevestigd is perfect. Nog geen datum means no date yet, and de leverancier is the singular subject responsible for the confirmation.
I do not know who can arrange access.
You do not know who can arrange the required access. Explain that uncertainty about the contact.
Wie introduces an embedded question and is its subject. Kan regelen is its final modal-infinitive group; niet negates your knowledge, not the possibility of arranging access.
The problem lies in the missing permissions.
Missing permissions are the source of the problem. Identify that blocker to colleagues.
Het probleem zit in means the problem lies in. In de ontbrekende rechten names the source of the difficulty; zit is not literal sitting here.
Can we put this question to the administrator?
The administrator should be asked a question about the blocker. Suggest putting that question to them.
Kunnen we is a joint suggestion. Voorleggen remains joined after the modal, and aan de beheerder names the recipient of the question.
More testing time does not solve this access problem.
More testing time will not solve the access problem. Explain why time alone is insufficient.
Oplossen splits as lost ... op. Meer testtijd is a singular amount with lost; niet negates solving this specific problem.
If the data arrives today, we can start tomorrow.
Your team can start tomorrow if the data arrives today. State that conditional start.
Als introduces the condition and de gegevens is plural with komen. The fronted clause is followed by kunnen we; morgen sets the conditional start time.
For the next step, we need a decision.
A decision is needed before your team takes the next step. State that dependency.
Voor de volgende stap gives the purpose or prerequisite context, not a calendar deadline. Hebben ... nodig expresses need; plural we controls hebben.
What is holding us back now?
Something is preventing your team from progressing now. Ask what is holding you back.
Wat is the question subject. Tegenhouden splits as houdt ... tegen; ons is the direct object being held back, and nu gives the time.
I reported the blocker this morning.
You reported the blocker this morning. Tell colleagues when you raised it.
Heb gemeld forms the perfect. Vanmorgen places the completed report this morning; it does not say the blocker has since been removed.
The other tasks are not blocked.
One task is blocked, but the other tasks are unaffected. Clarify that limited scope.
Plural de andere taken takes zijn. Niet geblokkeerd describes their unblocked state; the statement does not remove the blocker on the affected task.
May I outline the context first?
You want to give background before discussing a point. Politely ask to outline the context first.
Mag ik asks permission. Schetsen means outline here and follows the modal without te; eerst places the context before the rest of your contribution.
A colleague proposed an approach and you agree with it. Express your support.
Zich aansluiten bij is reflexive and separable: ik sluit me ... aan. Me matches ik, while bij dat voorstel identifies what you support.
I have no additional questions at the moment.
You have no further questions right now. Tell the meeting participants about that current state.
Geen aanvullende vragen negates additional questions. Op dit moment limits the statement to now, leaving later questions possible; heb is not an auxiliary here.
Can we discuss one topic at a time?
Several topics are being mixed together. Ask the group to discuss one topic at a time.
Kunnen we is a joint request. Eén onderwerp is the object of bespreken; tegelijk means at a time in this single-topic context.
S=Die uitleg|V=helpt|O=mij|TE=om het voorstel te begrijpen.
That explanation helps me understand the proposal.
An explanation helped you understand the proposal. Acknowledge what that explanation enables.
Mij is the direct object of helpt and the understood person doing begrijpen. Om het voorstel te begrijpen names what the explanation helps you do, rather than a separate actor's purpose.
I would like to understand why we are choosing this option.
You need to understand why the group selected an option. Explain the reasoning you want clarified.
Wil graag softens the wish and begrijpen stays infinitive. Waarom introduces the embedded reason-question, with we as subject and kiezen final.
Let me finish the sentence for a moment.
Someone interrupted you before your sentence was finished. Ask them to let you finish it.

Laat is imperative. Mij identifies the person allowed to do afmaken, while de zin is what is finished. Even softens the request rather than demanding a measured moment. Afmaken remains joined as a bare infinitive after laat.
How do the other colleagues see this?
You want the other colleagues' views on the current issue. Ask how they see it.
Hoe asks about their perspective. Plural de andere collega's takes zien, and dit is the issue viewed, not the grammatical subject.
We have five more minutes for this topic.
Five minutes remain for this topic. Tell participants about that remaining discussion time.
Hebben is finite with we. Nog vijf minuten is the amount of time available, and voor dit onderwerp allocates it to this topic.
Can you briefly repeat that last point?
You missed the last point in the discussion. Ask a colleague to repeat it briefly.
Kun precedes subject je. Herhalen remains infinitive, dat laatste punt identifies the repeated content, and kort describes brevity rather than a scheduled time.
S=Ik|V=zie|G=dat er nog een vraag is.
I see there is another question.
Another participant has a question. Acknowledge that you see another question waiting.
Dat introduces the observed situation. Er is introduces existence with singular een vraag as subject; nog een means another in this context.
Let's discuss the technical details separately.
You want a separate discussion of the technical details. Make that joint proposal.
Laten we includes the speaker in the proposal. Bespreken remains infinitive and apart means separately; it is not itself a clock time.
I have attached the action list to the minutes.
You attached the action list to the minutes. Report that completed addition to the meeting record.
Heb gevoegd forms the perfect. De actielijst is the attached object and bij het verslag identifies the record it accompanies.
The old date is no longer valid.
A previously recorded date has been replaced. Explain that the old date is no longer valid.
Niet meer means no longer. Geldig is a predicate adjective after is, without -e; the sentence rejects the old date's continuing validity.
Can we check the wording together?
The wording of the agreement needs reviewing. Suggest that the group check it together.
Kunnen we introduces the joint suggestion. Controleren stays infinitive, while samen describes joint participation rather than a time.
According to my notes, the test starts on Thursday.
Your notes say the test starts on Thursday. State that date while attributing it to your notes.
Volgens mijn notities is a fronted evidence-source phrase. Begint precedes de test, and op donderdag gives the scheduled day; the date is attributed to your notes.
S=Ik|V=wil|I=voorkomen|G=dat er twee versies van het besluit ontstaan.
I want to prevent two versions of the decision from arising.
You want one clear record so two different versions of the decision do not emerge. Explain what you want to prevent.
Wil takes bare infinitive voorkomen, inseparable in the sense prevent. Dat introduces the unwanted event, with plural twee versies and final ontstaan; er introduces their occurrence.
We have recorded the condition for approval.
Your team recorded a condition that must be met for approval. Report that documented condition.
Hebben vastgelegd is perfect with separable vastleggen. Voor goedkeuring names the approval the condition concerns; recording it does not assert that it has been met.
Who checks the minutes before they are sent?
The minutes need a reviewer before they are sent. Ask who performs that check.
Wie is the question subject. Voor verzending means before sending and sets the check's time relative to distribution; het verslag is the object reviewed.
The agreement applies only to the test environment.
During your team meeting, an agreement concerns the test environment only. Clarify that limited scope.
Geldt is singular with de afspraak. Alleen restricts voor de testomgeving to that environment; voor indicates scope here, not a deadline.
No decision has been made about the production environment yet.
No decision has yet been made about production. State that production remains undecided.
Over de productieomgeving is fronted. Geen besluit is the singular subject of passive is genomen; nog geen means no decision yet, not that production is forbidden.
Add the person responsible to the action list.
The action list needs to identify the person responsible. Tell a colleague to add that owner.
Toevoegen splits as imperative voeg ... toe. De verantwoordelijke is a noun for the person responsible; aan de actielijst names the destination record.
S=Ik|V=vraag|G=of iedereen dezelfde afspraak heeft genoteerd.
I ask whether everyone has noted the same agreement.
You want to check whether everyone recorded the same agreement. State the question you are asking.
Of means whether. Iedereen is singular with heeft genoteerd at the embedded clause's end; dezelfde identifies one shared agreement rather than different versions.
The team has confirmed the revised text.
During your team meeting, the team confirmed the revised text. Report that completed confirmation.
Het team is singular, taking heeft. Bevestigd is the participle and de aangepaste tekst is the text confirmed; revised does not mean a different actor confirmed it.
S=Ik|V=neem|O=de opvolging van dit punt|PP=op mij.
I take responsibility for following up this point.
You volunteer to own follow-up of the current point. State that responsibility.
Op mij nemen means take upon myself. Mij matches subject ik in this fixed responsibility expression; de opvolging van dit punt is what you take on.
We still need to confirm the deadline.
The group's deadline is still unconfirmed. State that confirming it remains necessary.
Moeten is finite with we and bevestigen stays infinitive without te. Nog marks an outstanding requirement; this is not completed confirmation.
The administrator will check access tomorrow.
During your team meeting, the administrator will check access tomorrow. Report that next-day action.
Zal is finite with singular de beheerder and controleren remains infinitive. Morgen sets tomorrow as the check time; the sentence does not report an already completed check.
Several actions are outstanding and the team must prioritise one. Ask which action takes priority now.
Welke actie is the question subject, with heeft. Voorrang hebben means have priority; nu asks about the current priority rather than a permanent ranking.
I will let you all know when the text is ready.
You will notify the whole group when the text is ready. State that notification commitment.
Laat jullie weten means let you all know; jullie are the recipients. In this scenario wanneer de tekst klaar is sets the notification time: once the text is ready, you will notify the group.
We have divided the tasks among the team members.
Your team divided the work among the team members. Report that completed allocation.
Hebben verdeeld forms the perfect. Onder de teamleden means among the team members, not physically underneath them; de taken is the object distributed.
S=Een naam op de lijst|V=is|C=nog geen bevestiging.
A name on the list is not yet a confirmation.
A name has been added to the action list, but the person has not confirmed ownership. Explain why the name alone is insufficient.
Een naam op de lijst is the singular subject of is. Nog geen bevestiging is a noun complement; naming someone does not itself report accepted responsibility.
Can you finish your action before the next meeting?
A colleague owns an action that should finish before the next meeting. Ask whether they can meet that deadline.
Kun precedes subject je. The second je is possessive in je actie; voor de volgende vergadering sets a deadline and afronden remains infinitive.
The next check is scheduled for Monday.
The next check is scheduled for Monday. Tell the group that scheduled day.
Staat gepland describes a scheduled state. Voor maandag means for Monday here, rather than automatically before Monday; context determines this use of voor.
If the action is delayed, we report that immediately.
Your team will immediately report any delay to an action. State that conditional reporting rule.
Als introduces the condition, with vertraging oploopt as the final group. Then main-clause melden we follows; dat refers to the delay and meteen means immediately.
Put the agreed date next to each action.
Every action needs its agreed date listed beside it. Tell a colleague to add those dates.
Zet is imperative, and de afgesproken datum is its object. Naast elke actie gives the placement in the list; elke requires singular actie.
Everyone has confirmed their own action.
Every action owner has confirmed their own action. Report that complete set of confirmations.
Iedereen is grammatically singular and takes heeft. Zijn eigen refers distributively to each person's own action; English naturally uses singular their here.
